## sqlpipe v2.0

This release changes the users API and improves performance.

### Breaking change: user names

The `name` field of `/v2/users` is now two fields: `first_name` and `last_name`. Update your code before you upgrade. A request that sends `name` will fail.

### New: incremental loads

The new `--incremental` flag copies only the rows that changed since the last run. Use it to make large jobs faster.

### Faster Parquet writes

Parquet writes are now 40% faster. You do not have to change anything to get this speed.

### How to upgrade

1. Change every `/v2/users` call to send `first_name` and `last_name`.
2. Test your integration against the new field names.
3. Add `--incremental` to the jobs that need it.
